rationale.consistency: Follows codebase style and conventions, though allocating strings in a hot loop is unidiomatic and inefficient.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails on multi-byte non-ASCII characters; string(byte) conversion and byte-wise EqualFold on UTF-8 fragments causes false mismatches.
rationale.scope: Perfectly scoped; implements only the requested suffix matching logic and removes unused code with no unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: The complex backward iteration is clearly structured and well-explained by comments, making the logic easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles out-of-bounds risks and malformed escapes without panicking, though functionally fragile for non-ASCII input.
rationale.maintainability: Cleanly encapsulated in a helper function, but manual backward byte iteration of UTF-8 is inherently error-prone and hard to extend.
